entries.en: A card with the shortest address in the deck
entries.body_en: The engine already names its worlds at the end of its own web address. So the card prints that, and nothing else.
entries._audit_body_en: Curated address #w=77777 — the engine's own hash grammar (readAddr(): w|s world/base, f fold, c crop, d depth; non-default geometry only). Defaults apply: fold 0 (open), crop slab, depth all. The engine reads the hash at LOAD, so a doorway opened into an already-open tab is a same-document navigation and does nothing (engine ring 1, public/bifurcata/index.html). Page built 2026-08-23 before the faces existed; the later face step renders from the live engine at #w=77777.
